title: Unblock a Pending PVC
prompt:
In namespace `cka-st-pv`, PersistentVolumeClaim `pvc-data` stays `Pending` despite matching storage capacity and access mode with `pv-data`.

Perform the following tasks:
1. Investigate and fix PersistentVolume `pv-data` so PersistentVolumeClaim `pvc-data` binds cleanly.
2. Do not delete PersistentVolume `pv-data` or claim `pvc-data`.
3. Ensure Deployment `web` in namespace `cka-st-pv` becomes `Ready`.

docs_links.label: Configure a Pod to Use a PVC

manifests:
apiVersion: v1
kind: PersistentVolume
metadata:
  name: pv-data
spec:
  capacity:
    storage: 1Gi
  accessModes:
  - ReadWriteOnce
  storageClassName: manual
  claimRef:
    namespace: cka-st-pv
    name: other-pvc
  hostPath:
    path: /tmp/cka-st-pv-data
    type: DirectoryOrCreate
apiVersion: v1
kind: PersistentVolumeClaim
metadata:
  name: pvc-data
  namespace: cka-st-pv
spec:
  accessModes:
  - ReadWriteOnce
  storageClassName: manual
  resources:
    requests:
      storage: 1Gi
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: web
  namespace: cka-st-pv
spec:
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: web
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: web
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: web
        image: nginx:1.27-alpine
        volumeMounts:
        - name: data
          mountPath: /usr/share/nginx/html
      volumes:
      - name: data
        persistentVolumeClaim:
          claimName: pvc-data

checks.failure_hint: The PV is pre-bound to other-pvc — remove the stale claimRef.
The Pod cannot start until the claim binds.

reference_solution:
Clear the stale claimRef.
```bash
kubectl patch pv pv-data --type=json -p='[{"op":"remove","path":"/spec/claimRef"}]'
```
hints: Check PV and PVC status with `k get pv pv-data` and `k -n cka-st-pv get pvc` to see why binding stalls.
A Released PV retains a stale `spec.claimRef` pointing to a deleted claim; remove `spec.claimRef` so the PV returns to Available.
